PropertyValueTechnique / conditionsSample & source
author interpretationMPS thiol binds/competes at ZnS surface after basification; three methoxysilane groups provide hydrolysable anchors. Figure 1 draws hydrolyzed MPS for convenience, not the purchased precursor.reportedAuthor source interpretationmechanismgerion2001 · Main PDF p. 3, printed p. 8863, Figure 1; gerion2001 · Main PDF p. 8, printed p. 8868, Discussion A
author interpretationAlmost water-free alkaline methanol permits slow partial hydrolysis and initial silanol hydrogen bonding, minimizing interparticle cross-linking. Trace water in TMAH solution is important.reportedAuthor source interpretationmechanismgerion2001 · Main PDF p. 8, printed p. 8868, Discussion A
author interpretationMild heating converts silanol bridges into covalent siloxane bonds with water release. Source describes hydrogen/van-der-Waals bridging qualitatively; no kinetic constants supplied.reportedAuthor source interpretationmechanismgerion2001 · Main PDF p. 8, printed p. 8868, Discussion A; gerion2001 · Main PDF p. 3, printed p. 8863, Figure 1
author interpretationFresh MPS/water builds a thicker shell, leaving thiol and silanol groups outward. First-grown shell alone is not stable in water. Shorter reheating limits fast cross-linking in wetter mixture.reportedAuthor source interpretationmechanismgerion2001 · Main PDF p. 8, printed p. 8868, Discussion A
author interpretationChlorotrimethylsilane terminates residual reactive silanols, limiting further growth and linking; hydrophobic groups reduce water solubility, offset by pre-added negative phosphonate functionality.reportedAuthor source interpretationmechanismgerion2001 · Main PDF p. 8, printed p. 8868, Discussion A
author interpretationThe source names (trihydroxysilyl)propyl methylphosphonate but Figure 1 draws a P-bound CH3/propyl motif with P=O and O−. Chemical naming/connectivity and counterion are unresolved; no exact charged molecular formula or alkali counterion inferred.reportedAuthor source interpretationmechanismgerion2001 · Main PDF p. 2, printed p. 8862, Chemicals and materials; gerion2001 · Main PDF p. 3, printed p. 8863, Figure 1
author interpretationLong empirically chosen waits are needed; authors do not know the reason and propose slow solvation. No equilibrium rate model or robust shortened protocol established.reportedAuthor source interpretationmechanismgerion2001 · Main PDF p. 8, printed p. 8868, Discussion A
author interpretationCentrifugal membranes remove small complexes while retaining nanoparticles; size-exclusion exchanges solvent. Silica-only spheres of similar size cannot be excluded by these steps.reportedAuthor source interpretationmechanismgerion2001 · Main PDF p. 8, printed p. 8868, Discussion A; gerion2001 · Main PDF p. 9, printed p. 8869, Discussion A
author interpretationAPS initial priming failure is tentatively attributed to weaker amine/Zn bonding than aliphatic thiol/Zn bonding. APS after MPS priming remains usable; mechanism explicitly uncertain.reportedAuthor source interpretationmechanismgerion2001 · Main PDF p. 9, printed p. 8869, Discussion A
